title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Amount Recovered for a Duplicate Mileage Posting
content:
When the mileage component stands twice among the pay postings of a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the second posting is the duplicate. The amount taken back for a duplicate mileage posting is the full amount of the later of the two mileage postings, rounded to the cent half up. It is taken back in one reversal against that later posting and never exceeds it.

## Elements

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Posting recovered | The later of the two mileage postings on the batch |
| Amount | That later posting's full amount, rounded to the cent half up |
| Number of reversals | One |
| Ceiling | Never more than the later posting's amount |

## Worked figures (hypothetical postings)

| Mileage postings on the batch | Later posting | Amount taken back |
|---|---|---|
| 4.35 on the completion date and 4.35 two days later | The 4.35 posted two days later | 4.35 |
| 3.10, then 3.15 on a later date | The 3.15 | 3.15 |
| A single posting of 5.20 | No duplicate | Nothing on this ground |

In the second case the amount follows the later posting (3.15), not the earlier one.
